subject: math
title: Area of Rectangles
seo_title: Grade 3 Area Worksheets: Unit Squares, Length × Width and Composite Shapes
standard_text: Relate area to multiplication and addition: find areas of rectangles and of shapes made from rectangles.
meta_desc: Free Grade 3 area worksheets: count unit squares, length × width, word problems, missing sides and L-shaped figures. 100 practice questions with pictures and a printable answer key.
key_big: Area of a rectangle = length × width, in square units.
key_sub: Area is the space inside a shape. Count the unit squares, or multiply the side lengths. For an L shape, split it into rectangles and add.
body_html:
What area means

Area is the amount of space inside a flat shape. We measure it by counting square units: squares that are 1 unit on each side.

Area of a rectangle

Area = length × width. Write the answer in square units: sq cm, sq in, sq m or sq ft.

ShapeHow to find the areaArea
4 cm by 6 cm4 × 624 sq cm
7 ft by 3 ft7 × 321 sq ft
Area 32, one side 88 × ? = 32other side 4
Example

A rug is 6 feet long and 4 feet wide. What is its area?

6 × 4 = 24.

Answer: 24 sq ft

Shapes made of rectangles

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding the sides (4 + 6 = 10)Area multiplies: 4 × 6 = 24
Finding the perimeter insteadPerimeter is the distance around. Area is the space inside
Writing cm instead of sq cmArea is always in square units

faq.q: What is the difference between area and perimeter?
faq.a: Area is the space inside a shape, measured in square units. Perimeter is the distance around the outside, measured in units of length.

faq.q: How do you find the area of a rectangle in 3rd grade?
faq.a: Count the unit squares, or multiply the length by the width. A 4 by 6 rectangle has 4 × 6 = 24 square units.

faq.q: How do you find the area of an L-shaped figure?
faq.a: Split it into two rectangles, find the area of each, and add the two areas together.
